formal.statement: theorem trace_classification_audit_certificate : (∀ (K : Type*) [Field K] [Fintype K] (E : WeierstrassCurve.Affine K) (r : ℕ), Nat.Prime r → r∣Nat.card E.Point → TraceSquares (Fintype.card K) (fieldTrace E) → (orderOf (Fintype.card K:ZMod r)=1 ∨ orderOf (Fintype.card K:ZMod r)=2 ∨ orderOf (Fintype.card K:ZMod r)=3 ∨ orderOf (Fintype.card K:ZMod r)=4 ∨ orderOf (Fintype.card K:ZMod r)=6) ∧ orderOf (Fintype.card K:ZMod r)≤6 ∧ Nat.Coprime r (Fintype.card K) ∧ (∃ P : E.Point,addOrderOf P=r)) ∧ (Nat.Coprime 81 289 ∧ 81∣(324:ℕ) ∧ TraceSquares 289 ((289:ℤ)+1-324) ∧ ¬ orderOf (289:ZMod 81)≤6)
formal.scope: Actual finite-field curve and prime divisor of actual point count, conditional on explicit integer trace-square classification: modular order in {1,2,3,4,6}, bound6, coprimality and actual prime-order point via Cauchy. Composite q289/N324/r81 control is arithmetic only; no actual curve/point81 claimed. Classification and modular-order/embedding-field identification remain open.
